attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Oklahoma state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per OK tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Oklahoma Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Oklahoma tax - Single filer (progressive brackets with personal exemption credit)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ok_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /ok_taxable_income xdef /result.ok_taxable_income xdef
0 /ok_tax xdef
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_1_limit min result.ok_bracket_1_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_1_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_2_limit min result.ok_bracket_1_limit sub 0 max result.ok_bracket_2_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_2_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_3_limit min result.ok_bracket_2_limit sub 0 max result.ok_bracket_3_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_3_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_4_limit min result.ok_bracket_3_limit sub 0 max result.ok_bracket_4_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_4_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_5_limit min result.ok_bracket_4_limit sub 0 max result.ok_bracket_5_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_5_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_5_limit sub result.ok_bracket_6_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_tax /result.ok_base_tax xdef
1 result.num_dependents add result.ok_personal_exemption_credit mul dup /ok_exemption_credit xdef /result.ok_exemption_credit xdef
ok_tax ok_exemption_credit sub 0 max dup /ok_tax xdef /result.ok_tax xdef
ok_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Oklahoma tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat " (Base: $" strconcat result.ok_base_tax cvs strconcat ", Exemption Credit: $" strconcat result.ok_exemption_credit cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Oklahoma military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize OK military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "OK Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from OK taxable income
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay get /result.ok_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
result.ok_subtractions get result.ok_military_retirement_exclusion get add /result.ok_subtractions xdef
"OK Military Retirement Exclusion (Full): $" result.ok_military_retirement_exclusion get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0 /result.ok_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "OK Military Retirement Exclusion: None (no military retirement pay)" job.audit_trail swap addto
